response.sql: SELECT Films.title FROM Films JOIN Film_Genres ON Films.film_id = Film_Genres.film_id JOIN Genres ON Film_Genres.film_genre_id = Genres.id JOIN Film_Stars ON Films.film_id = Film_Stars.film_id JOIN Stars ON Film_Stars.film_star_id = Stars.id WHERE Genres.genre IN ('Action', 'Adventure') AND Stars.star_name = 'Tom Cruise'
